digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Historical whole-file mutant count ceilings are stale (814 mutants in signing.py vs old record of 491), blocking unrelated work if enforced or normalizing defects if relaxed
Mutation testing gate must transition from blanket enforcement to phased modes (advisory/ratchet/strict) with explicit per-shard promotion criteria and evidence thresholds
Selector must map changed source/test/support and global inputs to shards, track renames/deletions, report unmatched Python tests, and skip on empty selection
Ratchet mode must preserve unchanged legacy survivors and no-tests outcomes while blocking killed-mutant regressions, new survivors, timeouts, and incomplete statuses for AST-identical functions

Workflow must use fresh isolated base/head archives without persisted verdict cache, pin mutmut 3.7.0 with max-children=1 and timeout_constant=1.0/timeout_multiplier=15.0, and cap each per-shard job at 30 minutes
Promotion from advisory requires three stable base/head pilot runs with max runtime ≤24 minutes; strict promotion requires all legacy non-killed outcomes individually reviewed or remediated
